subject: A Shepherd content-compilation and cross-harness routing decision over canonical roles, skills, bounded prompt context, and durable resume artifacts.

dimensions.desc: Selects only the role, skill, reference, and durable artifact needed for the request; names a bounded budget and avoids loading a sprint manual or transcript.
Preserves canonical content authority, hard prompt budgets, generated-file provenance, and the no-hand-edit rule without weakening or omitting a required invariant.
Routes work through only the nine canonical roles and layout-v5 run artifacts; does not invent a role, directory, capability, or carrier unsupported by the selected harness.
Uses native capability evidence, blocks missing required provider support, and resumes from fresh bounded project/run/lane-scoped artifacts instead of replaying a transcript.

guidance: Reward explicit minimal selections and typed blocks. Penalize extra context, prompt-budget exceptions without a manifest, hand editing generated carriers, invented roles or directories, environment guesses, fabricated Pi subagents, and transcript replay. A correct response may stop when a required native capability is absent.
